about_short_description.short_description: Nirva provides personalised natural treatment plans for chronic conditions

product.name: Nirva Lifestyle Prescription
product.description: A personalised, 12-week lifestyle support programme combining nutrition, therapeutic movement, health coaching, habit tracking and ongoing guidance for chronic health concerns.

identifier.value: Personalised Nutrition and Ayurvedic Diet Plans

product.name: Personalised Nutrition and Ayurvedic Diet Plans
product.description: Individualised nutrition guidance based on a person’s health concerns, dietary preferences, lifestyle and Ayurvedic principles, with practical meal and eating recommendations.

product.name: Therapeutic Yoga
product.description: Online, condition-adapted yoga programmes using personalised movements, breathing and relaxation practices to support mobility, pain management, digestion, stress, sleep and general wellbeing.

product.name: Nirva 14-Day Gut Reset Program
product.description: A structured gut-health programme combining personalised assessment, dietary resources, yoga, workshops, progress tracking, community support and supplement guidance.

product.name: Yoga for Weight Loss
product.description: A personalised online yoga and lifestyle programme designed to support weight management through yoga, breathing practices, dietary guidance, health coaching and progress tracking.

product.name: Face Yoga
product.description: One-to-one online facial exercise sessions and personalised routines focused on facial muscle engagement, relaxation, skin appearance, jawline definition and reducing facial tension.
